items.title: MPS shareholders reject merger with Mediobanca
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 29 OTT - The shareholders of Monte dei Paschi di Siena (MPS) on Thursday rejected a proposal for the bank to merge with Mediobanca. The proposal needed the support of two-thirds of the bank's capital to be approved, but 63.65% voted against, with only 32.91% in favour and 3.42% abstaining. The merger was part of CEO Luigi Lovaglio's plan to fend off a 33-billion-euro takeover ‌bid by Intesa Sanpaolo for MPS. Intesa Sanpaolo had asked MPS's shareholders to reject the merger, in view of its takeover. MPS took over Mediobanca, Italy's premier merchant bank, earlier this year. Lovag
items.titleIt: MPS shareholders reject merger with Mediobanca

His military training in Eritrea comes at a sensitive time for the region, with relations between Ethiopia and Eritrea deteriorating and renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia raising fears of a wider confrontation.  The appointment could cause concern in Addis Ababa, particularly as Somalia has strengthened its engagement with Eritrea and Egypt amid longstanding disputes with Ethiopia over sovereignty, regional security and access to the Red Sea. items.title: Opinion: The Horn of Africa Deserves Peace Not Crisis and Instability
items.description: Yet, behind these crises are millions of people who share deep historical, cultural, economic, and social ties. The region's greatest need today is not another confrontation or competing alliance, but sustainable peace, mutual respect, and regional cooperation. A Region Under Immense Pressure. The situation across the Horn of Africa and its neighboring countries illustrates how deeply interconnected regional security has become.
